args.script: op('/project1/proc_geo').outputConnectors[0].connect(op('/project1/proc_render')); geo=op('/project1/proc_geo'); [c.destroy() for c in list(geo.children)]; s1=geo.create(sphereSOP,'sphere'); s2=geo.create(torusSOP,'torus'); sw=geo.create(switchSOP,'selector'); n=geo.create(noiseSOP,'distort'); out=geo.create(nullSOP,'render_out'); s1.outputConnectors[0].connect(sw.inputConnectors[0]); s2.outputConnectors[0].connect(sw.inputConnectors[1]); sw.outputConnectors[0].connect(n.inputConnectors[0]); n.outputConnectors[0].connect(out.inputConnectors[0]); geo.par.soppath=out.path; sw.par.index.expr="1 if op('/project1/proc_ctrl')[0] > 0 else 0"; geo.par.ry.expr='absTime.seconds*40'
